entities.name: PMID:10735613
observations: Rat study measured splenorenal shunt blood flow (TTU) and portosystemic shunts (microspheres) in biliary, CCl4, DMNA cirrhosis and portal-vein-ligation hypertension.

SRS flow correlated with mesenteric PSS (r=0.61) and splenic PSS (r=0.54); vapreotide changed SRS flow but not microsphere PSS estimates, with change magnitudes uncorrelated (r=-0.1). Authors considered TTU SRS flow an accurate, sensitive collateral-flow measure.

entities.name: SRS flow validation limits
observations: In rat portal hypertension, splenorenal shunt blood flow correlated moderately with microsphere portosystemic-shunt estimates across models, but vapreotide-induced flow changes did not correspond to changes in microsphere estimates; it is useful but not interchangeable with total collateral burden in every pharmacological setting.
